text: - 大家好,歡迎來到Victus的課堂。今天我們也有Lucas和Joyce陪伴我們。Bob, a grade 8 student at Judy's school, had a talk with Judy.He learned about trees and the pollution effects on the earth.Now he wants to give a speech.First, let's read what he says.Read what Bob says, think about what he is talking about.What is Bob talking about?Bob listed four ways in his speech.They are all about fighting pollution.Who is probably listening to his speech?Maybe his classmates?Maybe his schoolmates?So, this is a speech made for students.Why does Bob make this speech?Do you have any idea, Lucas and Joyce?Maybe he thinks the environment around him or his school is terrible.He wants everyone at his school to help fight pollution.Maybe he wants everyone to help make the environment around his school clean.Good idea.What about you, Lucas?Maybe he is the leader of the school environmental protection group.He wants to call on the students at his school to join the group.Maybe he is a school club leader.He wants others to join his school and help protect the environment together.So, he is calling on people to fight pollution.Now, please read Bob's speech aloud by yourselves.Bob's speechNow, let me read the first sentence for you.We must stop polluting the environment.Now listen again.When I read stop polluting, I read them as one word, stop polluting.We find the last sound of stop is p.The first sound of polluting is p2.We should keep just one p sound.Don't pronounce the p sound at the end of stop.Make a short pause.Then quickly move to the word polluting.We call this word linking.When we read short words or sentences, when we find the last sound of the first word and the last sound of the first word as the same p sound, we usually make a short pause at the last sound of the first word.Then quickly move to the last word.This phenomenon is called a poetry storm in the sound of linking.There are many other situations in the sound of linking.We will continue to learn in Unit 2 and Unit 3.Now, let's look at more examples.Plant trees.Ask customers.Some machines.Best to.Now, please open your books and turn to page 9.Find the talk time section.Let's listen to the recording and read of it.Plastic cards.Some money.Clear report.Big group.Enough food.Good driver.Bob Brown.Most TV.Top prize.Nine nights.There is a big group of people outside.Bob Brown is a good driver.Pat Thompson stayed in this hotel for nine nights.I'm a good driver.I have some money to buy plastic cards.Now, please read Bob's speech again.Answer this question.Is Bob's speech a good one?What do you think of Bob's speech?Look at the four suggestions he made.What order are they in?The first suggestion.Can students plant trees everywhere?The second one.Who can ask customers to re-plant trees?The third one.Who can ask customers to re-use shopping bags?If you can ask, who would you ask to do this?Can his schoolmates follow these suggestions?So we can say, Bob's speech is not very logical.What must he do then?Of course, he must revise his speech.Let's try to help him.Later, Bob had a talk with his classmate Amy.Let's listen to them talking and tell what Bob and Amy are talking about.What can we do to fight pollution?Always put rubbish in rubbish bins.And stop using plastic bags for shopping.Anything else?Stop factories and cars from producing harmful gases.Plant more trees and flowers in the streets.And make our classrooms less noisy.Which ways are more important?I think that.What are they talking about?Yes, they are talking about ways to fight pollution again.Now, let's listen to them talking again.Answer two more questions.How many ways does Amy talk about?Which way is missing in the pictures?How many ways are mentioned in their conversation?Yes, totally five.Look at the pictures.Which way is missing?That's stop using plastic bags for shopping.Can you name the ways in the pictures?Yes, they are stopping factories and cars from producing harmful gases.Plant more trees and flowers.And put rubbish in rubbish bins.After Bob notes down Amy's ideas, what will they do next?Do you still remember what they said at the end of the conversation?Yes, they are going to rearrange the waste to fight pollution.They are going to pick out the more important waste first.Think about the waste they talked about again.Do all of them focus on the same kind of pollution?No, they don't.For putting rubbish in rubbish bins and stopping using plastic bags, they focus on lead pollution.For the third one, it focuses on air pollution.And for the last one, it focuses on noise pollution.For the fourth one, it aims to solve all pollution problems.So, all the tips or suggestions are in a random order.These suggestions are neither comprehensive nor standard.Can you help them to rearrange these suggestions?Now you will have one minute.The first one.The fourth one.The fifth one.The sixth one.The seventh one.Have you finished?Let's welcome Lucas to share his work with us.We should always put rubbish in rubbish bins in our daily life.We can ask our parents to stop using more plastic bags.We must not make a lot of noise at school.We can try to be volunteers to plant more trees and flowers.The governments can also encourage people to do so.It's difficult for us to stop factories and cars from producing harmful gases.Maybe it is the government's duty.Thank you Lucas.Now we have Lucas's list of the ways.He rearranged the last three ways on the list.Let's read Lucas's reason now.Lucas thinks students can follow the first way of putting rubbish in rubbish bins.They can also ask their parents to reuse shopping bags.At school, students can reduce the noise pollution themselves.But for planting more trees and stop pollution from cars and factories,he thinks we need the government's help.Students may not be able to make such changes to the environment.He listed the things we can do ourselves first.He listed the things we cannot do at the end.When he talks about the things we can do,he also put them in the order of students at home,students' parents, and then students at school.You should organize your thoughts and state them in order as Lucas did.But do we just give the ways or suggestions when we make such a speech?What else do we need to think about?Why does Bob call on the students to fight pollution?Can you think of some reasons for him?Yes, there are many different kinds of pollution on the earth.And people don't charity us.They are destroying their best fighters against pollution.And also the ice caps are 50% thinner than they were 50 years ago.We must take action to stop polluting the earth.Good, I think you have helped Bob a lot.If we don't stop polluting the environment,the earth will no longer be a safe place for people to live on.This can be a warning to people.This can also attract people's attention on global pollution problem.What will happen if the students follow Bob's tips?Good, they will surely have a good environment.And they will help the earth recover from pains.And also they can bring the earth a bright future.So at the end of Bob's speech, he should tell his classmates or schoolmates what they can achieve by following his advice or suggestions.Now, it's time for you to help Bob revise his speech.Thank you for watching this video.Now, let's invite Lucas again.Lucas, you can make your speech now.Dear friends, there is air pollution, land pollution, water pollution and noise pollution on the earth.If people do not stop polluting the environment,the earth will no longer be a safe place for people to live on.As students, we can do some things to help fight pollution.Always remember to put rubbish in rubbish bins.Stop using plastic bags for shopping.When you are at school, don't make a lot of noise.Stop factories and cars from producing harmful chemicals.It's not too late to stop polluting the environment.If everyone can give a hand, our earth will have a bright future.Let's read Lucas's speech together.He divides his speech into four parts.In paragraph one, he gives the reason why he wants to make this speech.He also provides some background information.In the second paragraph, he calls on his friends, classmates to take action.In paragraph three, he provides some ways, tips and suggestions.Finally, he states his hopes.Let's read paragraph three again.All these ways are listed in a logical order, but are they enough?Let's take a close look at the suggestions.I think we can give some details if possible.For the first suggestion, in Shanghai and many other cities in our country,do we put all the rubbish in the same rubbish bins?We don't do that any longer, so you should write this tip like this.Always put different kinds of rubbish in different rubbish bins.It helps cleaners deal with them easily.For the second sentence, you are explaining why you ask people to sort rubbish.You use the second sentence to explain why you need to sort rubbish.For the second tip, I would like to add something more.When we give suggestions, don't always tell people what they can't do.Tell them what they can do.So, you can ask people to take their own baskets or clothes bags when shopping.Also, you can tell them what problem they can solve.Now, let's summarize what we should do when we make a speech calling on people to fight against pollution.At the beginning of the speech, you should tell the audience the reason for the speech and introduce some background information.Also, you should call on people to participate and take action.Also, you should give them some advice.If possible, you should provide more details and tips.Of course, you should tell people what they should do instead of just telling them what they shouldn't do.At the end of the speech, don't forget to make your own wish.Now, all these pictures are about different ways to fight pollution.This time, choose one kind of pollution.Call on your classmates to take action and join you to help protect the environment.At the beginning of the speech, don't forget to make your own wish.Now, let's invite Joyce to share her speech with us.Are you ready, Joyce?All of you can find a checklist in Task 1 as well.Use the checklist to evaluate Joyce's speech.在任務一中找到核查表,看看你會如何評價Joyce的演講。Now, Joyce, you can start.Good morning, my dear friends.Do you find the air around you is no longer pure?Do you find the blue sky becomes grey sometimes?It's because of the air pollution.Should we work together to fight air pollution?Now, I have some suggestions for you.First, walk to school or ride your bicycle.If you live far away, take a bus or the underground.Don't ask your parents to drive.We can help reduce air pollution.When it is sunny, read or study by the window.Don't turn a lot of lights on.We can save energy and we can save more oil and coal.Then we will have less air pollution.Now, we have a lot of country parks in Shanghai, but we need more.We need to plant more trees to help fight air pollution.I hope you can join us to help make the air purer and cooler again.It's up to us to decide together what happens next.Thank you, Joyce.Lucas, what do you think of Joyce's speech?Let's see what score you give to her.Wow, you think she did a very good job.Can you give us your reason?I think Joyce did a very good job.At the beginning, she used the two questions to tell us why she wanted us to fight air pollution.It makes us interested in her appeal.She calls on us to join her to work together then.She wants us to work together.She then provided three tips.All these three tips are practical.It's easy to do.But I think she can have more, like asking adults to stop smoking, telling her father to drive less and so on.Finally, she repeated what she wanted us to do and gave her wish.So I gave her a total score of very good.Lucas didn't think she made enough suggestions.But as a speech, we needn't ask people to do too much, or they will be frightened away.I really think Joyce gave us an impressive speech.Boys and girls, can you revise your speech after class?Now, homework for today.今天的回家作業都已經列明在
